steps.title: Ask who the listed payer is paying for
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask who the listed payer is paying for
To: Borrower B0055, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0055)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - $835,699 (1.1% of inflows) came from 'Lakeshore Property Partners LLC', who is not a known customer or obligor [ref S3-B0055-NON_OBLIGOR_PAYER-917a4f3b]

Please provide for each listed payer, the customer it paid on behalf of and the arrangement that lets it pay (for example a parent company, an insurer or a factor) by 2026-10-11.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo

To: Borrower B0055, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0055)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:

Please provide proof of delivery and the customer's purchase order for each listed invoice by 2026-10-11.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.
